findings.evidenceJa: ビニールいっぱいの食材
findings.governingReading: 食材を手に describes the grocery bag he carries.
findings.explanation: Full of groceries becomes full or groceries.

findings.highlight: Illya shoots a glance at the shopping bag in my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける
findings.governingReading: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける has Shirou holding groceries and glaring at her before her curious stare back.
findings.explanation: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding the bag becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.

findings.evidenceJa: そう簡単にやられる訳には—
findings.governingReading: 俺だってマスターだ is followed by そう簡単にやられる訳には— within closed speech.
findings.explanation: His refusal to be defeated easily disappears and the dialogue is left unclosed.

findings.highlight: I don't like forcing people to do things.
findings.evidenceJa: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう
findings.governingReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう gives her fear of being disliked as the reason to leave despite not wanting to.
findings.explanation: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは女の子な訳だし
findings.governingReading: 俺は年上 and イリヤは女の子 supply separate age and gender rationales in Shirou’s thought.
findings.explanation: Illya being a girl as an additional reason to soften becomes simply her being a kid.

findings.highlight: I should know better than to say this, but I'm not mad.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない
findings.governingReading: 自分でもどうかと思うけど doubts the appropriateness of his not being angry.
findings.explanation: Questioning his own lack of anger becomes knowing better than to say it.

findings.highlight: As long as I've got her here
findings.evidenceJa: こうして捕まってしまった以上
findings.governingReading: こうして捕まってしまった以上 makes Shirou the caught party conceding to the chat she wants.
findings.explanation: Having been caught by her becomes having her here.

findings.highlight: who they sent to carry out their thousand-year-old obsession.
findings.evidenceJa: 最高のマスターとして送り出された
findings.governingReading: 最高のマスターとして specifies the role and quality with which the thousand-year lineage dispatched her.
findings.explanation: Being sent out as the highest Master loses that assigned excellence.

findings.evidenceJa: 期待しないで待っててね
findings.governingReading: 期待しないで待っててね asks him to wait while not expecting her, matching the deliberately coy conditional offer.
findings.explanation: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.
